name: Bitcoin-knots
tagline: Can be used as a desktop client for regular payments or as a full node server utility for merchants and other payment services.
description: Bitcoin Knots can be used as a desktop client for regular payments or as a full node server utility for merchants and other payment services.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/bitcoin-knots:version-29.4.knots20260508.1-noble1@sha256:c5f17ac3492af411bf83e2a62c1640be1b53b551570d3d39876c1b18bec82879
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8333
        published: 8333
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
